environment.description: Container running on ECS Fargate with default configuration. The container filesystem is read-write, /tmp is writable. The /admin/rotate-algorithms endpoint is exposed internally on the service mesh without additional authentication. An attacker with network access to the internal service port can call the rotate endpoint to add HS256 to allowed algorithms, then forge tokens using the public key as HMAC secret.

config.network: internal service mesh, no endpoint-level authz
